Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the confinement of a caged egg laying hen.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the confinement of a caged egg laying hen;amending RCW 16.52.185; adding a new section to chapter 16.52 RCW;prescribing penalties; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of restrictive confinement of a caged egglaying hen if he or she confines any caged egg laying hen, for allhours or the majority of the day, to a living space that does not alloweach caged egg laying hen sufficient space to fully extend both wingswithout touching the sides of the living space or other birds. (2) This section applies to commercial egg production andoperations that are required to be licensed under chapter 69.25 RCW. (3) This section does not apply to: (a) The confinement of caged egg laying hens in: (i) Individualized veterinary care; (ii) Lawful transport; (iii) Lawful slaughter; or (iv) Lawful state or county fair exhibitions; and p. 1 SB 6061 (b) RCW 16.52.185. (4) Restrictive confinement of a caged egg laying hen is a grossmisdemeanor, punishable as provided in RCW 9A.20.021. (5) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Egg laying hen" means a female domesticated chicken, turkey,duck, goose, or guinea used for the purposes of egg production. (b) "Living space" means any cage, crate, or other structure usedto confine caged egg laying hens.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 16.52.185 and 1994 c 261 s 22 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Nothing in this chapter applies to accepted husbandry practicesused in the commercial raising or slaughtering of livestock or poultry,or products thereof or to the use of animals in the normal and usualcourse of rodeo events or to the customary use or exhibiting of animalsin normal and usual events at fairs as defined in RCW 15.76.120.Section 1 of this act does not apply to this section.
